- I'll re-provision a static deep-dive link for the session and share it in this thread.
- Marissa (solutions engineer) will lead a 45-minute technical walkthrough focused on latency numbers, KV-cache behavior, and private deployment options. Ben (customer success) will cover rollout/onsite support and SLAs.

Proposed windows (all PT mornings, pick one):
1) Thu Apr 22 — 9:00–9:45am PT
2) Thu Apr 22 — 11:00–11:45am PT
3) Fri Apr 23 — 8:30–9:15am PT

If those don't work let me know two slots that do for you and Priya. I'm attaching a short qualification checklist and a proposed action plan so your infra team can pre-seed questions.

I will also send a calendar invite with the static link once you confirm.

Again — apologies. We'll make the next run smooth.

Thanks,

kimberly_park@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199
